div.div: BEHIND THE SCENES — what keeps the steps honest

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(218, 232, 252), rgb(29, 41, 59)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(108, 142, 191), rgb(92, 121, 163));

div.div:
Health checks — feed steps ③ and ⑥
Two ways to know a server is alive: ask it every few seconds (ACTIVE) and watch real requests fail (PASSIVE).

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(218, 232, 252), rgb(29, 41, 59)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(108, 142, 191), rgb(92, 121, 163));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 572px; height: 1px; padding-top: 658px; margin-left: 690px;

display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Safe deploy (draining) — feeds step ⑥
Mark the server DRAINING → no NEW requests → current ones finish → then update. After a time limit, force-close the stragglers.
